feedback: The current candidate shows a cautious reduction in kp to 0.48 and a slight increase in ki to 0.04, aiming to reduce oscillations and improve steady-state error correction. The sensor weights have been adjusted to [-0.35, 0.55, -0.35] to emphasize the central sensor and reduce side sensor influence, which should smooth steering. However, without telemetry data from the previous race, we cannot confirm if these changes have effectively reduced steering oscillation or improved line tracking stability. The line_loss strategy remains 'search_left', which is consistent but may limit recovery effectiveness compared to 'last_direction'. To improve, I recommend: 1) Slightly increase kd from 0.22 to 0.25 to add more damping and reduce any residual oscillations. 2) Adjust sensor_weights to [-0.3, 0.6, -0.3] to further increase central sensor influence and reduce side sensor impact, potentially smoothing steering corrections more. 3) Consider switching line_loss to 'last_direction' to improve recovery from line loss events, as previous data suggested this strategy can be more effective. These changes aim to reduce oscillations, improve recovery, and enhance overall line following stability and performance.
